quickly.line: But it all fades so quickly
stanza: I've seen my share of hustlers
As they try to take the world
But it all fades so quickly
They write down what you say

sickly.line: When you pass through humble, when you pass through sickly
stanza: When you pass through humble, when you pass through sickly
When you pass through, I'm better than you all
When you pass through anger and self deprecation
And have the strength to acknowledge it all
When the past makes you laugh and you can savor the magic
That let you survive your own war
You find that that fire is passion
And there's a door up ahead, not a wall
